verse.verse_1: By the (steeds) that run, with panting (breath),
verse.verse_2: Striking sparks of fire (by their hooves),
verse.verse_3: And scouring to the raid at dawn
verse.verse_4: And raise the dust in clouds the while,
verse.verse_5: Penetrating forthwith as one into the midst (of the foe);
verse.verse_6: Verily! Man (disbeliever) is ungrateful to his Lord;
verse.verse_7: And to that fact he bears witness (by his deeds);
verse.verse_8: And verily, he is violent in the love of wealth.
verse.verse_9: Knows he not that when the contents of the graves are brought out and poured forth (all mankind is resurrected).
verse.verse_10: And that which is in the breasts (of men) shall be made known.
verse.verse_11: Verily, that Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them (as to their deeds), (and will reward them for their deeds).
